assignment_method: Deterministic illustrative assignment, not fitted clustering

clusters.name: Access-constrained
clusters.description: Illustrative delivery friction with room to improve access and follow-through.
clusters.interpretation: Delivery conditions warrant investigation before assuming unwillingness to vaccinate.

clusters.name: Activation gap
clusters.description: Illustrative adequate access with uneven recommendation and follow-through.
clusters.interpretation: Access alone may not explain the gap; investigate recommendation, relevance and follow-through.

clusters.name: Enhanced-vaccine adoption gap
clusters.description: Illustrative reasonable flu coverage with uneven adoption of the enhanced category.
clusters.interpretation: Distinguish implementation of the category recommendation from Efluelda brand performance.

clusters.name: Strong delivery
clusters.description: Illustrative stronger uptake and delivery conditions with residual cohort gaps.
clusters.interpretation: Explore transferable practices while checking whether they would work in different local conditions.

driver_scale: 0–100 illustrative index; higher means stronger enabling conditions
